title: A failed encode of a tray or edit-box video leaves the editor with no player for good
trigger: Attach a video, open Edit Video, trim it so it needs encoding, press Done; the ffmpeg encode fails (for example the disk is full or the codec is refused).
effect: finish_video_editor sets editor.player = None before encoding; the Err arm only clears busy and sets the note. start_video_editor_player runs only from video_editor_probed, so the editor stays open showing a still picture: the loop does not play, a click on the picture does not pause or resume (toggle_video_editor_pause needs a player), and the playhead does not move. The user has to cancel and reopen the editor.
fix: Make the editor's stage one enum (Reading, Unreadable, Ready { player }, Encoding { serial }), with the player inside Ready. The encode's error arm then goes back to Ready and reopens the player. The avatar path in profile_photo_sources/video.rs already keeps the player.

title: still_busy sticks after a failed tray encode, so the cover still and the rotate/flip preview never update again
trigger: Open Edit Video on a tray video and drag the cover head, which starts a still cut. Press Done (Enter) before the cut lands, then let the encode fail.
effect: Done bumps editor.serial. The in-flight cut's answer no longer matches the serial, so it is dropped before still_busy = false runs. The encode's Err arm (video_editor.rs:504-509) does not clear still_busy, unlike the avatar path (profile_photo_sources/video.rs:111). Every later refresh_video_preview only stores still_wanted and returns, so the cover bubble, the still and the turned/mirrored preview stay frozen until the editor is reopened.
fix: Make the still cutter one value, enum StillCut { Idle, Cutting { serial, next: Option<i64> } }, matched by its own token instead of the editor-wide serial, so an encode does not orphan it. At minimum, clear still_busy in the tray/edit Err arm as the avatar path does.

title: The frame strip stays partly blank after an encode that started before the strip finished loading fails
trigger: Open Edit Video on a long video (or a video avatar) and press Done at once, while the strip frames are still being cut one by one. The encode fails.
effect: The strip loader checks editor.serial on each frame and stops when Done bumps it. When the encode fails, the editor stays open, but video_editor_reload_frames sees frames.len() == times.len() and the same width, so it treats the half-empty strip as kept and never reloads. The missing cells stay grey until the editor is reopened.
fix: Give the strip load its own stage (Loading { cancel, token } / Loaded / Stopped) keyed by its own token, not the editor serial, and reload when the stage is Stopped with frames missing.

title: A set sticker's New Sticker box can open with an older cover frame than the one chosen
trigger: Open the video editor for an owned sticker set, drag the cover head to a new frame and press Done before that frame's still cut lands.
effect: finish_set_video_editor takes editor.preview, which is the last landed still, not the still for edits.cover_ms. The cut in flight is then dropped because the editor is gone. The New Sticker box shows the previous cover frame, while the job encodes the chosen one.
fix: Keep the preview's frame time with it (preview: Option<(i64, PathBuf)>). When it does not match edits.cover_ms, the box asks for the cut itself instead of taking a stale picture.

title: VideoEditorDialog's stage is spread over info, timeline, note, busy, serial and player
trigger: Open Edit Video: the probe, the ready editor, an unreadable file and an encode are told apart by which Options are Some and by the busy flag.
effect: No bug beyond the two recorded for this struct (player and still_busy after a failed encode), but each new path has to keep info, timeline, busy, note and player in step by hand.
fix: enum EditorStage { Reading { serial }, Unreadable, Ready { info, timeline, player }, Encoding { info, timeline, serial } }, plus a separate StillCut value for the cutter.

title: EditorMotion keeps the strip drag, the seek throttle and the cover bubble/capture animation as loose Options and bools
trigger: Drag the cover head on the strip and let go: grab, head_dragged, seek_pending, seek_last, bubble, bubble_shown_at and capture change together across press, drag, release and tick.
effect: No bug found. The bubble's stages (hidden, growing, flying in, shown since, fading) are decided by which of capture, bubble_shown_at and bubble.target() are set, and the drag's by grab plus head_dragged.
fix: enum StripGesture { Idle, Held { grab, shift, head_moved, seek: Throttle } } and enum CoverBubble { Hidden, Showing(Fade), Capturing(Instant), Shown(Instant), Fading(Fade) }.

title: The 4-hour recheck replaces 'Updated to Quill X' without acknowledging the changelog, so the banner comes back on the next launch
trigger: Install an update and start Quill on 'Updated to Quill X'. Leave the banner and the Settings changelog alone, keep Quill running for 4 hours, then restart.
effect: UpdateState::Installed maps to UpdateControl::Check { busy: false }, so the timer's check_for_updates runs and overwrites Installed with Checking and then UpToDate. The banner and the 'Dismiss changelog' button disappear, but acknowledge_changelog never ran, so the result file stays and the next launch shows the banner again. A dismissed banner (update_banner_dismissed) is also reset by the check.
fix: Keep the changelog in its own value (Installed { release, dismissed }), apart from the check state, so a recheck cannot drop it. Or skip the timer check while Installed is unacknowledged.

title: A disk dip shorter than the download's reaction time leaves the update at 'Update Quill' instead of resuming
trigger: Let an update download start, then let the disk go Low and back to Healthy within a moment, before the download thread notices the hold.
effect: hold_update_download sets the hold. On Healthy, auto_download_update calls download_update, which returns at once because the state is still Downloading. The old download then fails as held and finish_update_download sets Available. Nothing starts it again until the next disk transition or the 4-hour check, so the title bar shows Update Quill instead of downloading.
fix: Make a held download a stage of its own (Downloading { held: true }) that resumes on Healthy when its answer lands, or have finish_update_download restart it when the disk is already healthy.

title: UpdatePill tracks the last control kind with a downloading bool and a nested Option<Option<Instant>> for ready
trigger: Watch the title-bar pill go from download to Restart.
effect: No bug found. follow() keeps downloading, ready and since in step by hand to decide whether to ease and when the swap began.
fix: enum PillMotion { Still, Filling { from, to, since }, Swapping { since }, Ready } derived from the last UpdateControl.

title: The frozen-account and age-check box flags stay set when their condition clears, so the box reappears unasked
trigger: Open the frozen-account details from the banner (or the age prompt by turning on 18+ content). The server lifts the freeze, or the age check is completed in the browser, while the box is open. Later the account is frozen again, or verification is required again.
effect: account_notice() shows Frozen only while freeze_info_open && sync.freeze.is_some(), so the box vanishes when the freeze clears, but freeze_info_open stays true. When freeze is set again in the same session, the box pops open without a click. age_verify_open has the same shape. The two flags and age_verify_started also describe one box with no single owner.
fix: One value for the open notice (enum OpenNotice { None, Frozen, AgeVerify { started } }), cleared when its condition goes away (in the dialog sync) as well as by Close and Esc.

title: A userpic player's slot holds its stage as hidden_since plus asleep, kept in step by hand
trigger: Scroll userpic videos out of view and back: the slot goes playing, off screen, asleep and revived.
effect: No bug found. Every writer sets asleep and clears hidden_since together, and State keeps sweep_due, timer and history_listed as extra flags.
fix: enum SlotStage { OnScreen, OffScreen { since }, Asleep } on Slot, with the player inside the awake variants.

title: A delete that never lands keeps a 60 fps redraw running for 10 seconds
trigger: Delete a message the server refuses to delete (for example an old message in a group without the right), or delete the only message left in a chat.
effect: begin_vanish pushes a Waiting ghost. merge_vanishing starts it only when a non-empty message list for its chat lacks the id: a refused delete keeps the message, and an emptied chat has messages.first() == None. Until VANISH_WAIT (10 s) prunes it, vanish_overlay sees a non-empty list and calls request_animation_tick(60) every frame, so the window redraws at 60 fps for 10 s with nothing animating. A deleted last message also gets no dust.
fix: Tick only for started ghosts. A Waiting ghost needs no frames, so wake it with the deletion update or a timer at VANISH_WAIT. Start the ghost from the deletion update (keyed by chat and message) rather than from the rows' absence.

title: Dust starts from where a row was last painted, which can be stale or off screen
trigger: Select several messages, scroll so some are out of view (or select some, scroll away and back elsewhere), then Delete.
effect: PAINTED keeps each row's last painted bounds until 4096 entries pile up, and begin_vanish uses them as they are. A selected row painted at another scroll offset makes its dust appear over other rows at the old position.
fix: Record the frame or scroll generation with each painted bound and use it only when it is from the current frame of that window, else crumble without dust.

title: Vanishing uses started: Option<Instant> as its stage, with grains empty until started
trigger: Delete a message: the ghost waits for the deletion, then crumbles.
effect: Phase is derived from started, requested and row, and grains is filled in only when started is set. Covered by the 10-second tick bug above.
fix: enum GhostStage { Waiting { requested }, Crumbling { started, grains } }.

title: The cover player and its failed clip are two Options for one stage
trigger: Open a Premium user's info panel with a video photo that fails to decode.
effect: No bug found. clip and failed are set and cleared separately, and sync_video_avatar reads both.
fix: enum Cover { None, Playing(CoverClip), Failed(FileId) }.

title: The live feed's off-screen policy is six fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Hide or cover a window that shows a video chat tile, then bring it back.
effect: No bug found. wake_view and note_live_paint both reset unseen, probed, unpainted_since and quiet, each in their own way.
fix: enum Sight { InView { seen, painted }, Unseen { count, unpainted_since }, Quiet { probed } }.

title: ControlsFade holds the full-screen timer as wanted plus hide_at beside full
trigger: Put the stream window in full screen and let the controls hide.
effect: No bug found. wanted and hide_at only mean something while full is set.
fix: enum Mode { Window, Full { shown_until: Option<Instant> } }.

title: clear_clip leaves speed_preview set, so a viewer whose speed drag was cut off keeps its controls up and shows a stale speed
trigger: In the media viewer, open the speed popover and drag its slider, then close the viewer (Esc, or the clip ends and the next opens) before the drag's Release reaches the slider. Open another video.
effect: speed_preview is cleared only by set_playback_speed (on Release or a preset). clear_clip resets seek_preview and volume_dragging but not speed_preview, so VideoControlsState::dragging() stays true: the controls never hide, and the speed label shows the preview instead of the real speed.
fix: One gesture value: enum ControlsDrag { None, Seek(f64), Volume, Speed(f64) }, reset whole by clear_clip.

title: VideoPip keeps the press, drag and slide, and the seek drag, as separate flags
trigger: Drag the PiP window to a screen edge, or drag its progress line.
effect: No bug found. press.dragging, dragged and slide decide together whether a button press counts and whether on_bounds_changed refits the window. seek_preview and paused_by_seek, and volume_dragging and volume_synced, are pairs set by hand. feed_left_told is a once-per-player flag.
fix: enum PipGesture { Idle, Pressed(Press), Dragging(Press), Sliding(Slide) } and enum LineDrag { None, Seek { preview, paused_by_seek }, Volume }.

title: Wallpaper preview Apply closes the box and switches to the Telegram wallpaper before setDefaultBackground answers
trigger: Settings > Chat wallpaper > pick a gallery wallpaper (or From file...) > Apply while the request will fail (e.g. offline flood wait, upload of a local file refused).
effect: The box closes as if saved; appearance.telegram_wallpaper is set true and wallpaper_rgb is cleared even though the server never set the wallpaper, so the chosen preset color is lost and the old Telegram wallpaper shows; the error only lands in chats_state.background_error, which the closed preview no longer shows.
fix: Keep the preview open in an Applying { request } stage of the preview value and close it (and flip the appearance) only on the matching setDefaultBackground answer; show the error in the box on failure.

title: Wallpaper Share link is copied whenever any getBackgroundUrl answer lands, not matched to the preview that asked
trigger: Open wallpaper A's preview, press Share, press Cancel before the link arrives (or open wallpaper B's preview); the getBackgroundUrl answer for A lands.
effect: close/open clear background_url only before the answer; the late answer sets chats_state.background_url and drain_wallpaper_preview copies A's link to the clipboard (overwriting what the user copied) and, if B's preview is open, shows 'Link copied' under B.
fix: Record the getBackgroundUrl RequestId in the preview (a Sharing { request } stage) and apply the URL only when its request id matches the open preview's.

title: Wallpaper preview state split between the screen's dialogs.wallpaper_preview and session-wide background_search/background_url/background_error reset by hand
trigger: Open/close the preview from the gallery, a bg/ link and the chat look box.
effect: open/close clear the session fields field by field; background_error is shared by nine background request purposes (set, delete, chat background, theme, URL), so opening a preview erases an error another page shows and a preview can show another flow's error.
fix: One preview value owning a stage enum (Looking(request) / Ready / Applying(request) / Sharing(request) / Failed(msg)), with answers matched by request id, instead of shared session slots.

title: If the wallpaper worker thread panics, every wallpaper area asks for an animation frame forever
trigger: Open a chat whose wallpaper render panics in Sources::render (e.g. a malformed pattern/photo that trips image/resvg); spawn_guarded catches the panic and the thread ends.
effect: Shared::threaded stays true, Board::running/wanted keep the dead job, nothing ever finishes, so lookup returns pending=true and request_animation_frame runs every frame in every window showing a non-solid wallpaper (CPU/battery drain) and the wallpaper never draws.
fix: Make the worker's liveness a value (Worker::Running/Dead) set when the guarded body returns, and fall back to inline rendering or a plain fill (no further frame requests) when it is dead.

title: Slot::Preview is one slot for every preview area in every window, so two previews replace each other's render forever
trigger: Open the chat wallpaper box (ChatLook) in a chat window and the wallpaper preview in the main window (or any two chat_look_preview areas of different size at once).
effect: Each frame one area's request replaces the other's queued/running job (replaces=true) with a 150 ms settle delay, so neither renders and both keep requesting animation frames.
fix: Hash the window id (and the owning dialog) into the preview slot as History does, or give each preview area its own slot key.

title: A render job's stage is spread over Board::queue, wanted, running and done kept in step by hand
trigger: Resize a window while a wallpaper renders.
effect: queued/running/done/superseded are four collections that request/next/finish must keep consistent (a key wanted for one slot short-circuits another slot's request).
fix: One map key -> JobStage { Queued(Job), Running, Done(Option<Rendered>) } plus a slot -> key map.

title: A pattern or photo that failed to read is remembered as None, and its fill-only result is cached under the same key
trigger: A pattern file read fails once (e.g. replaced while TDLib rewrites it) while its chat is open.
effect: remember() keeps the None, and the Cache entry for that (wallpaper,size) key holds the fill-only/empty picture, so the pattern/photo never appears until another wallpaper evicts it or the size changes.
fix: Do not remember failures (or remember them with a retry time), and do not cache a degraded render under the final key.

title: VideoPlayer Inner keeps asleep, awaiting and error beside the transport machine's state
trigger: Hibernate an inline tile, then call play()/seek on the handle; or let a clip fail.
effect: asleep duplicates 'backend is None' and the machine's Paused; play() on a hibernated player sets the transport to Playing while no backend exists (frame_demand masks it with !asleep); error is a take-once Option beside PlayState::Failed.
fix: A player stage enum (Open { backend, awaiting }, Asleep { orphan }, Failed(PlayerError)) so a sleeping player has no transport to play and the error lives in the Failed variant.

title: A file player stuck in Opening asks for a display frame every vsync with no limit
trigger: Open a clip whose backend never reports ready nor failed (AVPlayer item stuck unknown, a decoder that hangs opening).
effect: awaiting counts as animating while state is Opening regardless of AWAIT_PICTURE, so the element requests the next frame every vsync for as long as the view is shown (CPU/battery).
fix: Bound the Opening wait too (an open deadline that fails the player), or let the 50 ms open poll drive redraws instead of per-vsync frame requests.

title: TransportMachine::loop_sent is a 'loop seek in flight' flag beside PlayState::Playing
trigger: Play a looping GIF/round video to its end.
effect: loop_sent is cleared by hand in observe and sleep; no bug found.
fix: PlayState::Playing { looping_back: bool } or a Looping variant entered on Command::Loop and left when the position leaves the end.

title: Viewer controls auto-hide held as controls_hidden, controls_hidden_at, controls_gen and hide_timer bools
trigger: Move the mouse over the media viewer, wait for the controls to fade.
effect: hide_timer is a 'task waiting' flag cleared only inside the task; if the task's update ever returns Gone while the slot survives it sticks and controls never auto-hide again.
fix: ControlsVisibility { Shown { idle_task: Option<Task<()>> }, Hidden { at } } with the stored Task replacing the bool.

title: Viewer clip mode is seven fields cleared by hand in stop_viewer_video
trigger: Open a video in the viewer, step, close, open PiP.
effect: video, video_path, player, gif, clip_error, video_layer and session_tick describe one clip; stop_viewer_video clears some, session_tick is a 'task running' bool cleared inside the task, and video is a bare MessageId.
fix: ViewerClip enum (None / Playing { item: ChatMessage, path, player, layer, tick: Task } / Gif(path) / Failed(String)) replaced whole on step/close.

title: Viewer rotate/flip decode held as rotated, reorient_pending and reorient_gen
trigger: Press Rotate twice quickly in the photo viewer.
effect: A pending decode is an Option beside a generation counter kept in step by cancel_reorient; no bug found.
fix: Reorient { Idle, Decoding { target, token }, Ready(path, code, image) }.

title: The photo editor and its deferred open live beside the viewer state, not inside it
trigger: Open the photo editor from the viewer, then lock with the passcode (close_media_viewer).
effect: photo_editor and photo_editor_after are separate from MediaViewer state, so closing the viewer does not close the editor (doc 6.3 notes this); left for the photo editor files' owner to confirm.
fix: Make the editor a field of the viewer's open state so closing the viewer drops it.

title: Apps tab reads grossing_loading bool beside grossing_bots Option (a hand-made Fetch)
trigger: Open global search > Apps while getGrossingWebAppBots fails.
effect: The failure turns into an empty list, so the tab says 'No apps to show right now' instead of an error with retry; loading and loaded are two fields.
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>> for the grossing list, with the failure arm shown in the tab.

title: Emoji status access stuck in Granting when the toggle answer never comes
trigger: In a mini app, request emoji status access, press Allow (Premium); the toggleBotCanManageEmojiStatus request is dropped unanswered (stale-request sweep / reconnect).
effect: AccessStage::Granting has no timeout or other exit; every later web_app_request_emoji_status_access is answered 'false' as busy until the mini app window is closed.
fix: Give Granting the request id and a deadline (as PhoneFlow and SetRequest have) and leave it on a dropped request.

title: SetStage::Resolving { sent: bool } tracks the lookup by purpose, not by request id
trigger: Mini app calls web_app_set_emoji_status while other custom emoji lookups run.
effect: Whether the lookup is answered is judged by 'any GetCustomEmojiStickers in flight', so unrelated lookups delay it; no wrong result found.
fix: Resolving { request: Option<RequestId> } and match the answer by id.

title: InvoiceWatch holds the checkout's attempt stage as sending, failed and pending bools
trigger: Mini app opens an invoice; pay, get refused, retry.
effect: Three bools encode Idle/Sending/Failed/Pending and are reset by hand in observe (baseline debt).
fix: enum Attempt { None, Sending, Failed, Pending } in InvoiceWatch.

title: MiniAppWindow keeps ready, wedged, waiting_write_access, data_sent and closing_confirmation bools
trigger: Open a mini app that requests write access and sends data.
effect: waiting_write_access is a request-in-flight flag (cleared on answer, send failure or popup dismissal); ready/wedged are helper lifecycle stages.
fix: HelperState { Starting, Ready, Wedged } and WriteAccess { Idle, Checking(req), Asking, Allowing(req) } enums, as PhoneFlow already does.

title: One mini-app launch waits in one of three Options (awaiting_attach_bot, awaiting_search, awaiting_toggle) plus confirm
trigger: Click a t.me/bot/app link, then an ?startattach link before the first answers.
effect: Several Options can be Some at once for different launches; each answer is matched by bot id at best, and the poll's lifetime is computed from all of them.
fix: LaunchFlow enum { Searching(PendingOpen, req), FetchingAttachBot(..), Confirming(WebAppConfirm), Adding(PendingOpen, req) } in one field.

title: Mini app render_action is one slot; a second action before the next render drops the first
trigger: In one poll tick the mini app sends web_app_open_invoice and the user picks 'Open bot' from the menu (or two events arrive together).
effect: The OpenInvoice action is overwritten, the checkout never opens and the app never hears invoice_closed.
fix: A queue (Vec<RenderAction>) drained at render, or answer 'failed' to an invoice action that is replaced.

title: Mini app open answers are applied in arrival order, not to the launch the user asked for last
trigger: Click a bot's menu button app, then quickly another bot's app before the first opens.
effect: Both launches stay pending; the first answer opens app A, the second replaces it with B (A flashes); if B fails A stays open though the user asked for B. Two answers in one 30 ms tick overwrite open_result, so A's launch is never closed with closeWebApp.
fix: Keep only the latest asked launch as current (drop older pending launches and close their answers), and make open_result a queue or keyed by request.

title: awaiting_toggle continues on any attachment-menu toggle answer, not the one it waits for
trigger: Accept 'Add to attachment menu' for bot A, and before it answers use 'Remove from menu' in another open app's menu.
effect: The remove answer (Ok) is taken as A's add answer and launches A's app; A's later answer is then a stray note.
fix: Carry the bot id (or request id) in awaiting_toggle and match the toggled answer to it.

title: Mini app from_window is one per screen and overwritten by every later flow
trigger: Start a ?startattach link in a chat window (waits for getAttachmentMenuBot), then open any mini app from the main window.
effect: from_window becomes None, so the first flow's Add-to-menu box and notes open in the main window instead of the chat window that asked.
fix: Keep the asking window inside each pending flow value (PendingOpen/LaunchFlow) instead of one shared field.

title: Phone share answer is matched by bot only; a timed-out send's late answer is reported for the next request
trigger: Mini app requests phone, Share; TDLib takes over 30 s (slow network) so the flow times out and tells the app 'cancelled'; later the app (or the same bot reopened) requests phone again and Share.
effect: The app was told cancelled though the contact card was sent; the stale phone_share (bot, done) then finishes the next request immediately with the old outcome.
fix: Keep the send's RequestId in PhoneFlow::Sending and accept only that answer; clear phone_share when the flow leaves Sending.

title: What's New window held as window Option plus opening bool
trigger: Click What's New twice quickly.
effect: Closed/Opening/Open is two fields; no bug found.
fix: enum WhatsNewWindow { Closed, Opening, Open(AnyWindowHandle) }.

title: A widget press or hover sticks when its bubble stops painting mid-gesture
trigger: Press on a widget message and scroll the history (wheel) so the bubble leaves the view before releasing, or switch chats while hovering it.
effect: The mouse-up/move handlers are only registered while the canvas paints, so entry.pressed stays Some and later moves reach the widget as a drag; entry.hovered stays true with no hover-leave.
fix: Release the press/hover when the widget is not drawn in a pass (the per-window seen pass already exists) or on window blur.

title: Canvases::read multiplies widget-supplied w*h*4 unchecked
trigger: A widget calls getImageData with huge width and height.
effect: Overflow panics in debug; in release it wraps, passes the length check and loops w*h times on the widget runtime thread (hang).
fix: checked_mul for w*h*4 and cap w*h at MAX_PIXELS; cap put_image's w*h the same way.

title: Message widgets in a locked, minimized or tray-hidden window stay 'visible': their runtimes keep running and their public data keeps being polled
trigger: Open a chat with a bot widget that watches its public data (RuntimeEvent::Watch(true)) in a chat window; press Lock (or minimize the main window showing it, or hide it to the tray). Leave it for minutes.
effect: WidgetEntry::visible is cleared only by a drawn history pass (reconcile_widgets), by the main window's next drawn frame without a conversation, or by closing a chat window. A locked chat window runs no upkeep (render_locked) and a hidden window draws no frame, so the widgets stay visible: their QuickJS runtimes keep running timers on their threads, schedule_widget_polls keeps sending getWidgetPublicData every period and background queries still go to the bot while Quill is locked or nobody can see them.
fix: Make a widget's on-screen state follow the window's own state (a per-window `Shown { window, view } | Hidden { since }` set from the lock, occlusion and hide events): close_for_lock and the window hide call widgets_left_window, and polls start only for widgets shown in an unlocked, visible window.

title: A hidden widget whose runtime still wants frames notifies its view on every landing, and is not ticked again when it comes back
trigger: Open an animated widget (CSS animation / requestAnimationFrame) in a chat window and scroll it off screen; keep another animated widget visible in the main window. Then scroll the first one back into view.
effect: hide_widgets sets entry.wants_frames = false but the runtime's Outbox::wants_frames stays true (a hidden runtime is never ticked, so its frame request stays). land_widgets compares the masked entry value with the runtime's, so every landing (60 per second from the other widget) marks the hidden entry changed and notifies the chat window's history view: that window redraws at the animation rate while showing nothing that moves. When the widget comes back, reconcile_widgets does not restore wants_frames, so it is not ticked until its own runtime happens to poke again.
fix: Keep the runtime's wish as its own field (`runtime_wants_frames`) and derive tick eligibility as `visible && runtime_wants_frames` where widgets_frame_start reads it; compare only the runtime value in land_widgets.

title: WidgetEntry keeps the runtime's stage in `lifecycle` and its per-runtime data in separate fields reset by hand
trigger: Read start_widget, the Stopped/Failed arm of widget_event, the release in start_waiting_widgets and the identity change in reconcile_widgets: each sets runtime, lifecycle, queries, theme, wants_frames, crashes, polled by hand, and each resets a different subset (pressed, hold, hovered, selection, cursor, frame and queries are left behind by some).
effect: No user-visible bug by itself today; it is how P3 widget findings (stale press, stale frame after a content change) arise.
fix: Carry the runtime and everything that belongs to it in the live variants: `Lifecycle::Loading(Live) | Running(Live)` with `Live { runtime, queries, theme, wants_frames, cursor, press: Option<Press> }`, so a stop, release or restart drops all of it at once.

title: WidgetEntry::pressed sticks when the release never reaches the widget, turning later hovers into drags
trigger: Press and hold the mouse on a widget, scroll the history with the wheel (or let the widget restart) so its input layer is no longer under the pointer, release, then move the mouse over the widget again.
effect: The mouse-up listener is only registered while the widget's input layer is painted, and nothing clears `pressed` on hide, stop or restart. The next moves over the widget are sent as Pointer action 1 (a drag with the old button) instead of Hover, and the new runtime gets a release for a press it never saw, until the next full click.
fix: Hold the press in the live runtime state (`Live::press: Option<Press>`) so a stop or restart drops it, clear it in hide_widgets, and end it on a window-level mouse-up rather than the layer's.

title: Widget on-screen state is `visible: bool` plus `hidden_at` (0 while visible) plus `window`/`view`, kept in step by hand
trigger: hide_widgets sets visible=false and hidden_at=clock; reconcile_widgets sets visible=true and hidden_at=0; widgets_left_window moves window/view without touching the others.
effect: No bug found from this pairing alone.
fix: `enum Placement { Shown { window: Option<ChatId>, view: Option<EntityId>, width: f32 }, Hidden { since: u64 } }`.

title: `WidgetsUi::landing: bool` marks a detached landing loop as started
trigger: watch_widget_runtimes sets landing with mem::replace and detaches the spawn_screen task; nothing clears the flag, the loop ends only when the screen is replaced (which replaces the flag too).
effect: No bug today because WidgetsUi lives in OnScreen; a future owner change (or any other exit from the loop) would leave landing true and no frames or events would ever land again.
fix: Store the task: `landing: Option<Task<()>>`, so the loop's existence and the flag are one value and dropping the owner cancels it.

title: Widget query tokens restart with every OnScreen while their answers queue in the account's Session, so an old answer can match a new query
trigger: Tap a widget control that sends a query to its bot (slow bot); before the answer, switch to another account; switch back and tap the same widget again before the old query is answered.
effect: WidgetsUi::last_query is reset to 0 by the account switch (OnScreen), but the pending getWidgetQueryAnswer belongs to the account's Session, which survives in the background and appends its answer to bots.widget_answers. After switching back the new runtime asks again with token 1; a late answer to the old token 1 for the same WidgetKey is delivered to the new query.
fix: Make query tokens process-wide (a static counter) or tag them with the ScreenEpoch, so a token is never issued twice for one account session.

title: A failed widget storage write is not retried: `unsaved` is cleared before the write
trigger: Use a widget that writes localStorage while the disk is full or the widget folder is not writable; free the space; quit Quill (or let the widget be pruned).
effect: save_widget_storage takes `unsaved` with mem::take before storage::save; on error it only logs. The entry is clean, so the farewell, the debounce timer and prune_hidden_widgets never write it again; the widget's local storage is lost at the next start unless it changes again.
fix: Clear `unsaved` only after storage::save succeeds (or keep a `Storage { Clean | Dirty | Failed }` value per entry and retry on the next timer).

title: Widgets start at the main window's scale even in a chat window on another display
trigger: Put the main window on a 1x display and a chat window on a 2x (Retina) display; open a widget message in the chat window.
effect: WidgetsUi::scale is written only by the main window's render (app_render/mod.rs), so start_widget picks the main window's device-pixel ratio for every widget: a widget in the chat window on the 2x display is rendered at 1x and drawn blurry (or at 2x and wasted memory the other way round). If the main window never drew (started hidden to the tray), every widget starts at the 2x default.
fix: Keep the scale per window (in Passes, written by each window's frame start) and start a widget at the scale of the window it is shown in.

title: A public data poll that is never answered leaves the widget in Poll::Asking for good
trigger: Watch a widget with public data; lose the connection or have TDLib drop the pending getWidgetPublicData without an answer (client restart).
effect: Poll::Asking is left only by a WidgetAnswer::PublicData. The error answer exists (bots/widgets.rs), but a request that is dropped with no answer leaves the entry asking, and schedule_widget_polls never polls it again until the entry is pruned or the screen is replaced; the widget's live data stops updating.
fix: Give Asking a deadline (`Asking { since: Instant }`) after which it returns to Due, or tie it to the request id the driver returns so a dropped request ends it.

title: New widget content keeps the old content's frame and height, so a new runtime that fails shows the old picture as 'stopped'
trigger: A bot edits a widget message to new HTML that fails to start (or crashes before its first frame) while the message is on screen.
effect: The identity change resets runtime, lifecycle, crashes and polled by hand but keeps frame and height. The Failed event then finds entry.frame set and records Lifecycle::Stopped, so the bubble keeps drawing the previous content's last frame with the stopped state instead of the failure; poll also carries over.
fix: On an identity change replace the entry's content-bound part whole (frame, height from the stored value, poll, live runtime), e.g. `entry.content = ContentState::new(identity)`.

title: The per-window applied-frame map keeps an entry for every window ever opened
trigger: Open and close chat windows, call windows and notification popups for a long session.
effect: APPLIED (thread-local HashMap<WindowId, bool>) gains an entry per window in sync() and nothing removes it when the window closes: state that outlives its window, a slow leak.
fix: Keep the applied frame in the window's own state (WindowSlot / the window view) or remove the entry from when_window_goes.

title: The X11 connection is cached for the process even after it breaks
trigger: On X11, have the X connection fail after first use (Xwayland or the X server restarted under a running session, or the connection hits an error); then use Close to tray / pin on top / Show taskbar icon.
effect: CONNECTION keeps the first RustConnection forever; once it errors every set_visible, set_always_on_top, set_skip_taskbar and is_minimised call fails silently (hide does nothing, minimised reads false) until Quill restarts.
fix: Drop the cached connection when a request on it fails (`Option` replaced by `Connected | Broken`), so the next call reconnects.

title: Player::seek clears `eof` but not `error`, so a clip that hit a decode error keeps reporting it after a seek that works
trigger: Play a video with a corrupt stretch so decoding fails mid-way (State::error set), then seek back to a good part (or let a looping inline clip loop).
effect: seek() resets eof, the queue and the clock, and the decode thread resumes decoding, but State::error stays Some; Player::error() and FfmpegBackend::status().failed keep saying the clip failed, so the transport stays Failed although pictures decode again.
fix: Hold the decode stage as one value: `enum Decoding { Running, Ended, Failed(String), Stopped }` that a seek replaces whole (Failed -> Running when the seek is accepted).

title: The decode thread's stage is `eof`, `error`, `stop` and `seek` flags in State
trigger: ExitReport, the open failure, decode_loop::turn and Player::seek each set eof and error together by hand; stop is checked separately; error implies eof by convention only.
effect: Bug found: the seek clears one flag and not the other (separate entry).
fix: `enum Decoding { Running, Seeking(f64), Ended, Failed(String), Stopped }` in State.

title: Player keeps its playback stage in `first`, `ended` and `last_pts`, reset by hand in seek
trigger: Player::seek resets first, ended and last_pts one by one; update_ended and play read them in combination with Clock::held.
effect: No bug found today.
fix: `enum Shown { NothingSinceSeek, Showing { last_pts: f64 }, Ended }` replaced whole by a seek.

title: Clock stage is two bools (`playing`, `held`) plus an optional anchor
trigger: seek sets held, follow clears it, release clears it only if set, play/pause toggle playing; Player::update_ended and decode_loop::paint_floor test the combinations.
effect: No bug found today.
fix: `enum Run { Paused, HeldAfterSeek { playing: bool }, Running { anchor: Instant } }` with base and rate beside it.

title: VideoNoteCapture uses `child: Option<Child>` as its running flag and an emptied `path` as its handed-over flag
trigger: ended() sets child to None when ffmpeg exits by itself; finish() takes the path with mem::take so Drop knows not to delete it; Drop branches on both.
effect: No bug found today.
fix: `enum Capture { Recording(Child), Ended(Result<(), String>), Finished }` owned by the struct, path removed by Drop only outside Finished.

title: Cancelable ffmpeg extraction is a shared `Option<Child>` slot plus an `AtomicBool cancelled` kept in step by two threads
trigger: wait_for_cancelable_child checks cancelled before and after publishing the child, and treats an emptied slot as cancellation; the UI side sets the flag and takes the slot.
effect: No bug found; the protocol is correct but lives in two values.
fix: One `Mutex<Extraction { Starting, Running(Child), Cancelled }>` value both sides lock.

title: The install receipt records its outcome as `failed: bool` (baseline debt)
trigger: write_result(.., failed) and startup_state read the bool; startup_state also compares the version to tell 'installed' from a stale receipt.
effect: No bug found.
fix: `enum Outcome { Installed, Failed }` serialized in the receipt (keeping `failed` readable for old receipts).

title: The update helper gives up after 30 s of waiting for the app to exit and starts the old Quill again while the first one is still quitting
trigger: Press Restart to update while Quill takes long to quit (several accounts closing TDLib, a slow disk), or on Unix after the pid is reused by another process.
effect: restart_to_update hands off and calls cx.quit(); wait_for_parent polls kill(pid, 0) for 30 s at most. If the quit is slower, install() fails, apply_plan writes a failed receipt and relaunches the old version, which then meets the still-running process (single-instance lock) and opens with 'Update installation failed'. A reused pid has the same effect.
fix: Wait on something only the parent holds (the claim's lock, already shared with the helper) instead of the pid, with no fixed deadline while that lock is held.

title: Voice encoder thread failure mid-recording is never surfaced: the bar keeps recording and the preview waits forever
trigger: Start a voice note; while recording, the encoder's push/pause fails (disk full, the capture folder removed, an Opus encode error). Keep talking, press Pause, then press the preview Play button; finally press Send.
effect: VoiceCapture::failure only reads the mic error slot and the zero-samples idle check, never whether the worker thread already returned Err. The timer keeps counting and the bars freeze; Pause never sets Control::flushed, so toggle_record_preview shows 'Getting the recording ready' on every press forever; only Send reports the error, after which the whole recording is deleted.
fix: Let failure() also report a finished worker (JoinHandle::is_finished, or an encoder error slot the thread writes before returning), so check_recording ends the recording with the reason at once.

title: Encoder pause handshake is two atomics (paused, flushed) kept in step by hand
trigger: Pause, Resume, Pause on the voice record bar.
effect: Recording / pausing / paused-and-flushed is spread over Control::paused (UI writes) and Control::flushed (worker writes) plus the worker's local `paused`; preview_path reads the pair. No bug today beyond the one above (flushed never set when the worker died).
fix: One AtomicU8 stage (Recording, PauseAsked, Flushed, Failed) written by both sides with compare-exchange, so a dead worker is a stage too.

title: VoiceCapture fixture vs live mode is three fields (live None, fixed_seconds Some, keep_file true)
trigger: Screenshot demo builds VoiceCapture::preview; real recording uses VoiceCapture::start.
effect: elapsed_secs, sample_bar, preview_path and discard each branch on a different one of the three fields; a mix (live with fixed_seconds) is representable.
fix: enum Source { Live(Live), Fixture { seconds: i32 } } inside VoiceCapture; keep_file and the fixed duration follow from the variant.

title: Player first/ended/last_pts and Clock::held are one presentation stage kept in step by hand
trigger: Seek, step forward/back while paused, or let a clip end.
effect: seek sets first=true, ended=false, last_pts=None and clock.held; take_frame_for and step_forward clear first and release the clock separately; update_ended reads first and held together ('running = !first || !held'). No bug found today.
fix: enum Presenting { AwaitingFirst, Showing { last_pts }, Ended } on Player, with the clock's hold derived from AwaitingFirst.

title: Ceremony::finished bool next to the event receiver
trigger: A ceremony ends with Registered/SignedIn/Failed or its worker panics.
effect: poll sets finished on a final event and uses it to synthesise one 'worker stopped' failure on disconnect; the stage (running / finished) is a bool beside the channel. No bug today.
fix: enum CeremonyState { Running(Receiver<CeremonyEvent>), Finished } so poll after the end cannot read the channel again.

title: CTAPHID Assembly uses a `started` bool with cmd/total/next_seq/data
trigger: A key sends an init packet followed by continuation packets.
effect: started gates whether continuation packets are accepted and is reset by hand when a message completes; cmd/total/next_seq are meaningless while !started. No bug today.
fix: enum Assembly { Idle, Reading { cmd, total, next_seq, data } }.

title: Windows Cancellation is a `cancelled` bool plus an Option<GUID> in-flight id
trigger: Press Cancel in Quill's passkey dialog before or during the Windows Security dialog.
effect: Idle / in flight / cancelled are encoded as (false,None) / (false,Some) / (true,_); begin, end and cancel each update the pair. No bug today.
fix: enum Cancellation { Idle, InFlight(Option<GUID>), Cancelled }.

title: macOS scanner Shared keeps `stopped` beside an Option<Sender> that stop() also clears
trigger: The phone ceremony stops scanning (advert found, Use a security key, cancel).
effect: Two fields say the same thing (stopped, events None) and send checks both; told is a once-flag. No bug today.
fix: Let `events: Mutex<Option<Sender>>` alone mean running/stopped and drop the `stopped` atomic.

title: Bridge req_ids are cut to 64 chars, so the reply carries a req_id the page never sent
trigger: Open a mini app whose SDK uses request ids longer than 64 characters, and have it call readTextFromClipboard or invokeCustomMethod.
effect: clipboard_text_received / custom_method_invoked come back with the truncated req_id; the page matches replies by req_id, so its promise never settles and the action looks hung.
fix: Refuse an over-long req_id outright (BadArguments with a failure reply) instead of truncating it, so the answer always carries the id that asked.

title: A refused popup or custom-method request gets no reply event, so the page waits forever
trigger: A mini app calls showPopup with a 300-char message or 4 buttons, or invokeCustomMethod with params over 16 KB.
effect: parse_event returns Err(BadArguments) and spawn_mini_app_window drops it silently (`if let Ok(parsed)`); the page never gets popup_closed / custom_method_invoked with an error and its callback never fires.
fix: Make bad arguments of request-style events produce the bridge's failure reply (popup_closed with no button, custom_method_invoked with an error and the req_id) like `refusal` does for unsupported ones.

title: A security key Quill may not open (no udev rule) reads as 'no key' after the whole timeout
trigger: On Linux without the u2f udev rule, plug in a security key and choose 'Use a security key' / start a passkey ceremony.
effect: open_all logs 'cannot open /dev/hidrawN' every 500 ms poll and returns nothing; Link::devices waits until the request deadline (60 s) and the dialog then says no security key was found, never that access was denied.
fix: Return the open error from open_all (an enum Found { Keys(..), Denied(path) }) and end the ceremony with a permission error the dialog can show.

title: The PIN asked for one key is tried on every plugged-in key in turn
trigger: Plug in two FIDO2 keys with different PINs, sign in with a passkey that lives on the second key, enter its PIN.
effect: run_login asks for the PIN when key B says PIN_REQUIRED, then the next round starts again at key A with B's PIN; A answers PIN_INVALID, the user is told 'Incorrect PIN' and A's retry counter drops (eventually blocking A). The PIN is not matched to the key that asked.
fix: Carry the key that asked for the PIN (device path/index) with the PIN and try it only on that key in the next attempt.
